authority_principle: La metodología es la autoridad; el software únicamente la ejecuta.

open_methodological_decisions.title: Handling of historical PARTIAL status reference
open_methodological_decisions.description: Historical reference in methodology/cqs.md mentions PARTIAL status (0.0 < s(ci) < 1.0). The active CQS v1.1 frozen result model strictly permits PASS, FAIL, N/A, and UNEXECUTED. PARTIAL is isolated as an open methodological decision and is inactive in the production scoring engine.
